active.detailsHtml: Fabric Customers in Asia and US regions may experience intermittent failures while interacting with Copilot Service and, accessing ML experiments and Models.  Engineers continue to investigate the issue and are actively working to identify the underlying cause and restore full service functionality. The next update will be provided as more information becomes available.
